Eligibility (Advt 13/2025, Librarian)

  1. A B.Lib with one year of experience, or
  2. A B.A./B.Sc with a library diploma and the experience the advertisement lists.
  3. Punjabi at matriculation level.

School Librarian rules are set by the Education Department and can differ; check that advertisement separately.

Age, fee and pay

  • Age: 18 to 37 years; up to 42 for SC and BC of Punjab, 45 for government employees, 47 for persons with disabilities, 40 for widows and divorcees.
  • Fee: General Rs 1,000; SC/BC/EWS Rs 250; ex-servicemen Rs 200; persons with disabilities Rs 500.
  • Pay: Rs 29,200 (Level-5, 7th CPC) for the 2025 posts.

Advt 13/2022 notice - eligibility and pay (official)

PSSSB Advertisement No. 13 of 2022 was published on 21 May 2022; applications ran from 23 May to 22 June 2022 (fee until 27 June 2022). The notice set two levels of qualification:

Librarian

  1. A Bachelor of Library and Information Science from a recognised university, with experience in a government or government-recognised institution, or
  2. A B.A./B.Sc. plus a Diploma in Library Science, with at least three years' practical experience in an organisation registered under the Factories Act, 1948 or in a government or government-recognised institution.

Diploma-level library post in the same notice: 10+2 plus a two-year Diploma in Library Science.

For all: Punjabi at matriculation level (Punjab Civil Services Rules, 1994).

  • Pay: Rs 29,200 as per the 7th CPC, as printed in the notice.

Frequently asked questions

What is the qualification for PSSSB Librarian?

For the Technical Education posts in Advt 13/2025 - a B.Lib with one year of experience, or a B.A./B.Sc with a library diploma plus experience as set out in the advertisement. Matric-level Punjabi is also required.
